detection:
    selection_dismhost:
        Image|endswith: '\DismHost.exe'
        ParentCommandLine|contains|all:
            - '/Online'
            - '/Disable-Feature'
            # - '/FeatureName:'
            # - '/Remove'
            # /NoRestart
            # /quiet
    selection_dism:
        Image|endswith: '\Dism.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - '/Online'
            - '/Disable-Feature'
            # - '/FeatureName:'
            # - '/Remove'
            # /NoRestart
            # /quiet
    condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate script
